name: Everyone in My Party Thinks She's the Main Character
source:
You arrive in Aurelmont as its promised Hero, until the court reads your status: Support Class: Party Manager. Assigned to Pennywhistle's worst adventurers, you juggle three heroines who each consider you her sidekick. Your choices decide whose story takes center stage, while your support skills turn their spectacular failures into a working party.

[From [url=https://pomomi.com/series/everyone-in-my-party-thinks-shes-the-main-character]the official website[/url]]
translation:
你作为受诏降临的勇者来到奥雷尔蒙特，谁知宫廷当众宣读出的面板状态却是——辅助职业：队伍管理员。被分配去带佩尼惠斯尔最差劲的一群冒险者后，你不得不周旋于三位全都把你当成自己专属跟班的女主角之间。你的选择将决定谁的故事登上舞台中央，而你的辅助技能则会将她们惨不忍睹的频频翻车化作一支真正能打的队伍。

[摘自[url=https://pomomi.com/series/everyone-in-my-party-thinks-shes-the-main-character]官方网站[/url]]
